summary:
### TL;DR
- No GitHub Changelog entries in this period, so there are no announced platform changes, deprecations, or deadlines.
- The Dependabot docs now say that **NuGet** projects, not just npm, can get security fixes for vulnerable transitive dependencies. ([commit](https://github.com/github/docs/commit/bb241c41f404f748d043aab5349453aea403d9fb))
- The other docs commit, for the "Mo's Diner" landing page, only adds category tags to existing pages. It does not change any guidance. ([commit](https://github.com/github/docs/commit/c68452c1bacd5ff57b238209d8609eb392d3d82d))

### Action required
Nothing this time.

### Security improvements
- **Dependabot security updates for NuGet transitive dependencies.** This comes from a docs clarification, not a changelog announcement, so it may describe existing behavior rather than a new feature. For NuGet projects that use `PackageReference`, Dependabot handles a vulnerable transitive dependency in two steps:
  - It first tries to update the parent dependency.
  - If no compatible parent update exists, it adds a direct reference that pins the transitive dependency to the secure version.
  
  .NET teams should expect Dependabot PRs that add new direct `PackageReference` entries. Reviewers should know why those entries appear. ([Dependabot errors reference](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/reference/supply-chain-security/troubleshoot-dependabot/dependabot-errors), [commit](https://github.com/github/docs/commit/bb241c41f404f748d043aab5349453aea403d9fb))

### Docs changes worth reading
- **[About Dependabot security updates](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/concepts/supply-chain-security/dependabot-security-updates)**
  - **Old text:** Only npm could update a parent dependency, or remove an unneeded sub-dependency, to fix a vulnerable transitive dependency. Other ecosystems could not update a transitive dependency if that required a parent update.
  - **New text:** The note now says Dependabot can update transitive dependencies, but the method depends on the ecosystem.
  - The provided diff cuts off before the per-ecosystem details, so check the live page for the full list.
  - [Commit](https://github.com/github/docs/commit/bb241c41f404f748d043aab5349453aea403d9fb)
- **[Dependabot errors – "tries to update dependencies without an alert"](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/reference/supply-chain-security/troubleshoot-dependabot/dependabot-errors)**
  - The page now describes the NuGet `PackageReference` behavior: try the parent update first, then fall back to pinning the transitive dependency directly.
  - This helps explain unexpected Dependabot PRs in .NET repositories.
  - [Commit](https://github.com/github/docs/commit/bb241c41f404f748d043aab5349453aea403d9fb)

The Mo's Diner commit only added category tags to existing pages, including the Actions [Python build/test tutorial](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/tutorials/build-and-test-code/python) and several code-security pages. It is skipped as a non-substantive change.
